functions.name: add-site

FunctionInput_bing_webmasters_addsite.description: An existing website to register in the connected user account.

FunctionOutput_bing_webmasters_addsite.description: Acknowledgement of the submitted site registration, not ownership verification or newly created state.

tags.instructions: Use this to register an existing website in your account. Then use `get-site` for verification codes and `verify-site` after configuring ownership proof. Adding an already registered site is allowed; the result does not indicate whether it was newly added.

FunctionOutput_bing_webmasters_adduserto.description: Acknowledgement of the submitted delegation, not a read-back of effective permissions.

tags.instructions: Use `list-sites` for the parent site and `list-site-roles` to inspect existing access first. Obtain the delegation authentication code from the owner or the site's verification information; it is a real provider verification value, not a confirmation. This grants access and may affect existing permissions; inspect roles before repeating an uncertain request.

functions.name: block-url
functions.description: Request a page or directory block for a verified site, choosing cache-only or full removal.

url.description: Absolute URL of the page or directory to block; directory trailing slashes are preserved.

siteUrl.description: Exact registered, verified site URL under the connection's account.

entityType.description: Whether the target is one page or a directory.

requestType.description: Block only the cached copy or request full removal from search results.

FunctionInput_bing_webmasters_blockurl.description: Verified site, target URL, target kind, and requested Bing block mode.

accepted.description: Bing returned its successful acknowledgment; search-result propagation is not established.

FunctionOutput_bing_webmasters_blockurl.description: Acknowledgment of the block request, without a propagation or expiration guarantee.

tags.instructions: Use when the user wants a page or directory blocked in Bing, not deleted from their website. You need the verified site URL and target URL. Use `list-blocked-urls` to inspect current blocks and `unblock-url` to remove one. Full removal affects search visibility; cache-only affects the cached copy. This returns acceptance of the request, not proof that search results have changed.

tags.instructions: Use `list-query-parameters` first to inspect existing entries. This creates a normalization setting, not a query string on a hosted page. The provider chooses the new entry's initial enabled state; inspect it afterward and use `enable-query-parameter` or `disable-query-parameter` if needed. Parameter names are restricted to the conservative character set in the schema.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation scoped to this site and target URL; omitted when exhausted.

FunctionOutput_bing_webmasters_listurlli.description: One page of inbound links and an optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use a verified site from `list-sites` and a target page URL. This lists inbound links, not child pages or outbound links. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same siteUrl and url to continue. Page size is controlled by Bing, so no limit is accepted.

functions.name: remove-feed-from-site
functions.description: Remove an existing feed registration from a site in Bing Webmaster Tools. This does not delete the hosted sitemap file.

feedUrl.description: Exact URL of the registered feed to remove.

siteUrl.description: Registered URL of the verified site from which to remove the feed.

FunctionInput_bing_webmasters_removefeed.description: Site and existing feed registration to remove.

feedUrl.description: Feed URL targeted by the acknowledged removal request.

siteUrl.description: Site URL targeted by the acknowledged request.

accepted.description: Bing acknowledged the removal without a fault; not a separate read-back verification.

FunctionOutput_bing_webmasters_removefee.description: Acknowledged feed registration removal, without read-back verification.

tags.instructions: Use `list-feeds` to obtain the feed URL before removing its registration. This changes the site's feed configuration, not the file on your web server. There is no documented undo or restore operation here; do not assume removal removes indexed pages.

functions.name: unblock-url
functions.description: Remove a matching cache-only or full-removal block on a page or directory without changing website content.

url.description: Exact URL of the blocked page or directory, obtainable from list-blocked-urls.

siteUrl.description: Exact registered verified site URL owning the block.

entityType.description: Kind of target on the matching block.

requestType.description: Removal mode of the block to remove; other modes are not implicitly removed.

FunctionInput_bing_webmasters_unblockurl.description: Identity of the single page or directory block to remove.

accepted.description: Bing acknowledged the unblock request; indexing and cache visibility are not guaranteed.

FunctionOutput_bing_webmasters_unblockur.description: Acknowledgment of the unblock request, not a guarantee of search visibility.

tags.instructions: Use `list-blocked-urls` first to obtain the exact URL, entity type, and request type of the block. Use `block-url` for the opposite action. Unblocking removes that restriction but does not guarantee immediate inclusion in Bing search results or restoration of a cached copy.

functions.name: update-legacy-deep-link-weight
functions.description: Replace one legacy deep link's weight, including disabling it from showing on the search results page. Bing marks this interface obsolete in favor of deep-link blocks.

weight.description: Complete replacement of this deep link's weight. disabled prevents showing it on the SERP; other values retain provider legacy ranking semantics.

siteUrl.description: Exact registered verified site URL owning the legacy deep link.

deepLinkUrl.description: Exact existing deep-link URL whose weight to replace.

algorithmUrl.description: Algorithm URL containing the deep link, obtainable from legacy reads.

FunctionInput_bing_webmasters_updatelega.description: The registered site, existing legacy deep link and complete replacement weight.

accepted.description: Bing acknowledged the legacy weight update; search-result propagation is not established.

FunctionOutput_bing_webmasters_updateleg.description: Acknowledgment of one legacy deep-link weight replacement, without a search-result guarantee.

tags.instructions: Use only for an explicit legacy weight-management task. Get the algorithm URL and deep-link URL from `list-legacy-deep-links` and its related algorithm-URL list. Choosing disabled suppresses the deep link from the search results page; the website content is not deleted. Bing recommends deep-link block management instead and may reject this obsolete operation. Inspect the legacy links before retrying an uncertain write.

functions.name: verify-site
functions.description: Ask Bing to verify ownership of a site already in the connected user's site list and return whether verification succeeded.

siteUrl.description: Exact URL of the site already added to the connected user's site list.

FunctionInput_bing_webmasters_verifysite.description: The registered site whose ownership Bing should attempt to verify.

siteUrl.description: Site URL submitted for verification.

isVerified.description: Boolean result of this verification attempt; false means verification did not succeed.

FunctionOutput_bing_webmasters_verifysit.description: The submitted site and the Boolean result of one ownership verification attempt.

tags.instructions: First add the site with `add-site`, obtain codes with `get-site`, and arrange the required ownership proof on the website or DNS. This attempts verification once; false is a normal result, not an error. Use `get-site` if you only need to read the current verification state.
